description: This file defines functions and constants for managing Google Chat channel secrets, including secret registry entries, secret reference resolution, and runtime configuration collection.

methods.name: resolveSecretInputRef
methods.description: Resolves secret references from input parameters, returning explicit and inline references.

methods.name: collectGoogleChatAccountAssignment
methods.description: Collects and assigns Google Chat account secrets, issuing warnings if necessary.

methods.name: collectRuntimeConfigAssignments
methods.description: Collects runtime configuration for Google Chat channels, including account assignments.
